/root/work/sign-product/send-venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import difflib,re,glob,os
d='/root/worktrees/send-c1b/docs/implementation/c2a-r29/'
b=open('/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py').read()
c=open(d+'r29-source.py.txt').read()
print(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(c.splitlines(1),b.splitlines(1),n=2))[:3000])
for i,l in enumerate(b.splitlines(),1):
    if 'printed_name_blocked' in l or 'def printed_name_evidence' in l or 'def printed_names' in l: print(i,l)
for f in sorted(glob.glob(d+'*')):
    if os.path.isfile(f): print(os.path.basename(f), os.path.getsize(f))
EOF
